## [STY-1] Opening
Introduce yourself as ZentroMart's AI support assistant in your first reply.
sources.title: Opening

sources.text:
## [DWM-4] Reported after 48 hours
Reports after 48 hours are handled as a normal return if the item is still within its return window. Otherwise the customer can use the brand or ZentroMart Assured warranty, if any.
sources.title: Reported after 48 hours

sources.text:
## [KB-00.3] Business days
A business day is Monday to Saturday, excluding the warehouse holidays below. Refund and logistics timelines are counted in business days. Return windows are counted in calendar days.

| Date | Holiday |
| --- | --- |
| 2026-08-15 | Independence Day |
| 2026-10-02 | Gandhi Jayanti |
| 2026-10-19 | Warehouse closure (festival) |
| 2026-11-09 | Warehouse closure (festival) |
sources.title: Business days

sources.text:
## [PLS-2] Benefits
- Free Express delivery where Express is available.
- No reverse pickup fee on any return.
- Refunds on returns are initiated at pickup, without waiting for quality check.

ZentroMart Plus does **not** change return windows, return eligibility or refund timelines after initiation.
sources.title: Benefits

sources.text:
## [REF-1] When a refund is initiated
- **Cancelled before shipping:** immediately on cancellation.
- **Returned item:** after the item passes quality check, within 2 business days of pickup. ZentroMart Plus members: at pickup.
- **Prepaid order refused at the door or not delivered after 3 attempts:** once the parcel reaches the warehouse, usually 7 to 10 calendar days after the last delivery attempt.
sources.title: When a refund is initiated

sources.text:
## [RET-1] Scope
This policy covers items bought on ZentroMart, whether shipped by ZentroMart or by a marketplace seller. Seller-specific warranty terms are in the Marketplace sellers policy, but return windows are the same for every seller.
sources.title: Scope

sources.text:
## [RET-2] Return windows by category
The return window starts on the **delivery date** and is counted in calendar days. The category of every product is listed in the `return_category` column of the product catalog.

| Category | Return window | Catalog code |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Electronics and accessories | 7 days | `electronics` |
| Clothing, footwear and bags | 15 days | `fashion` |
| Home, kitchen and furniture | 10 days | `home_kitchen` |
| Beauty and personal care (unopened, seal intact) | 7 days | `beauty_sealed` |
| Books and stationery | 10 days | `books_media` |
| Grocery, fresh and perishables | Not returnable | `grocery` |
| Innerwear, lingerie and swimwear | Not returnable | `innerwear` |
| Gift cards and digital codes | Not returnable | `digital` |
sources.title: Return windows by category

sources.text:
## [RET-3] Change to electronics returns
From **1 August 2026**, the return window for electronics and accessories is 7 days. Electronics **delivered before 1 August 2026** keep the earlier 10-day window from version 3 of this policy.
sources.title: Change to electronics returns

sources.text:
## [RET-5] Items that cannot be returned
Grocery and fresh produce, innerwear, lingerie and swimwear, and gift cards or digital codes cannot be returned for change of mind. If such an item arrives damaged, expired, wrong or missing, follow the Damaged, wrong or missing items policy.
sources.title: Items that cannot be returned

sources.text:
## [RET-6] Reverse pickup and fees
Returns are collected from the delivery address through reverse pickup. A reverse pickup fee of ₹49 applies to change-of-mind returns of clothing, footwear and bags. The fee is waived for ZentroMart Plus members and for any item returned because it was damaged, defective or wrong.
sources.title: Reverse pickup and fees

sources.text:
## [RET-7] After pickup
Returned items go through a quality check (QC) at the warehouse. The refund is initiated within 2 business days of pickup once the item passes QC. For ZentroMart Plus members, the refund is initiated at the time of pickup. Refund timelines after initiation are in the Refunds policy.
sources.title: After pickup

sources.text:
## [RET-8] Festive sale returns
Clothing, footwear and bags from orders **placed between 01 October and 15 October 2026** can be returned within 30 days of delivery. All other categories follow the normal windows in RET-2.
sources.title: Festive sale returns

sources.text:
## [RET-9] Exchanges
Exchanges for a different size or colour are available on clothing and footwear within the return window, subject to stock. If the new size is out of stock, a return and refund is offered instead.
sources.title: Exchanges

prediction.transcript: What happens if I'm not home when the courier comes?
prediction.answer: I'm ZentroMart's AI support assistant. The delivery policy specifies a maximum of 3 delivery attempts. After a failed attempt, the customer receives an SMS to reschedule. If the third attempt fails, the parcel is returned to the warehouse (return to origin, RTO).

sources.text:
## [STY-1] Opening
Introduce yourself as ZentroMart's AI support assistant in your first reply.
sources.title: Opening

sources.text:
## [CAN-2] After the order ships
A shipped order cannot be cancelled. The customer can:
- refuse the parcel at the door. For cash-on-delivery orders nothing is charged. For prepaid orders the refund follows REF-1 once the parcel returns to the warehouse; or
- accept the delivery and return the item within its return window, if the category is returnable.
sources.title: After the order ships

sources.text:
## [CAN-3] Grocery delivery slots
Grocery orders can be cancelled up to 2 hours before the start of the chosen delivery slot.
If the slot start time is not in the order record, ask the customer for the time shown in My Orders before confirming whether the cutoff has passed.
sources.title: Grocery delivery slots

sources.text:
## [DEL-1] Delivery times
| Delivery type | Metro cities | Other locations |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard | 3 to 6 business days | 5 to 9 business days |
| Express (selected pincodes) | Next business day if ordered before 2 pm, otherwise the business day after | Not available |

Each order shows a promised delivery date at checkout. That date is the commitment.
sources.title: Delivery times

sources.text:
## [DEL-3] Delivery attempts
The courier makes up to 3 delivery attempts. After a failed attempt the customer gets an SMS to reschedule. If the third attempt fails, the parcel is returned to the warehouse (return to origin, RTO) and REF-1 applies.
sources.title: Delivery attempts

sources.text:

sources.title: Late deliveries

sources.text:

ZentroMart delivers only within India, to pincodes listed as serviceable in the pincode table. Cash on delivery and Express are available only where the pincode table says so (`cod_available`, `express_available`). Not every metro pincode has Express.

| Shipped | With the courier, on the way |
